The Andhra Pradesh Ministry led by one of the following passed a Bill on Land Reforms
x:
The Land Reforms Bill was introduced and passed during the tenure of P. V. Narasimha Rao as the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1971–1973). The legislation aimed at imposing ceilings on agricultural landholdings, distributing surplus land to the landless and reducing rural inequalities. These reforms formed an important part of agrarian policy in Andhra Pradesh.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).

In which place the Antiarrack agitation was launched by Women in 1991
x:
The Anti-Arrack Movement began in 1991 in Dubagunta village of Nellore district. The movement was led primarily by rural women, who protested against the widespread consumption of arrack because it resulted in domestic violence, indebtedness and poverty. The movement soon spread throughout Andhra Pradesh and ultimately influenced the State Government to impose prohibition on arrack. The movement is regarded as one of the most successful women-led social movements in India.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
